required_refinements.title: Specify the atomic checked-boundary handoff and complete delivery audit path
required_refinements.evidence: Core currently computes types/failures/entity/policy separately. Delivery is guarded and excluded from typing.jobs. job_audit_json requires both a failure job row and typing.jobs row, so the planned delivery candidate necessarily fails that ordinary filter. Failure jobs describe the ordinary run callee through CallEdge, not private dispatch/completion; a new phase must not be mistaken for those ordinary failures. Existing checked export chains diagnostics, not a delivery-completeness model.
required_refinements.refinement: Name one core finish boundary after all prerequisite Error diagnostics are available. It consumes typed candidates and schedules, validates all bindings, and alone constructs the opaque model and commits private nodes. Define unsupported/pending diagnostic ownership explicitly: normal core analysis must never clear arbitrary frontend errors, leave a placeholder guard that makes completion impossible, or let semantic-only candidate output masquerade as complete checked delivery. The guarded path remains until the whole static integration exists. Require every authored descriptor to have exactly one completed binding or an Error before checked export. Audit assembly must select ordinary schedules from typing.jobs and delivery schedules from completed DeliveryModel, not require a delivery entry in typing.jobs.
required_refinements.minimal_recipe: A core-private finish_delivery_candidates(parsed,graph,typing,failures,entity_model,policy) -> DeliveryModel owns constructor access and diagnostic publication. Candidate records remain explicitly untrusted/incomplete facts. Build and publish all checked rows/nodes only after gates pass; do not expose a partial graph or candidate as checked. Aggregate job audit includes exactly one row per ordinary or completed delivery job, with a nested versioned delivery contract. Retain ordinary run failure/effect facts separately from binding-owned service outcomes and unresolved durable dispositions.
acceptance: Valid typed descriptor appears once in public jobs audit, metadata/source facts and approval impact even though typing.jobs has no ordinary delivery row.
One failed hook/seal/phase prerequisite leaves no checked delivery node or row and causes normal check/approval/export refusal; no valid-looking empty jobs array.
Standalone semantic candidate data remains labelled incomplete and cannot supply a checked core delivery export.
Plain jobs remain unchanged. Mixed plain/delivery projects retain both row classes without duplicate schedules.
Independently expected rows and fresh rehashed omission tests reject deleting delivery, schedule, phase or graph relation evidence. Target still returns JOB_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
required_refinements.classification: Integration-plan refinement, not a claim that the currently guarded implementation exports a bad row. No additional owner decision or duplicate full gate.

required_refinements.title: Define exhaustive typed mutation-footprint coverage before certifying the two hooks
required_refinements.evidence: Existing policy/entity summaries aggregate effects by entity and cannot prove that a mutation does not touch due/sent fields. UpdateExpression can write through changes, conditional_changes, a whole patch, or transition; lifecycle transition declarations separately carry set fields. Merely finding the named create and patch site and scanning literal field writes misses a patch containing due_at or a transition touching reminder_sent_at. Owned callables and route inline bodies are also separate source surfaces.
required_refinements.refinement: Specify a source-wide typed write census over root/owned callables, inline route bodies, all nested expression/block branches, create sites, patch record effective fields, explicit/conditional sets and lifecycle initial/transition/generated declarations. Classify exact logical target and effective field identities before matching the unique allowed sites. Reject any additional create of the bound entity or any due/sent mutation outside those sites, including a whole-record patch or a lifecycle transition. Unrelated status/delete mutations are allowed only after their actual footprint is proved disjoint. Unknown patch target/origin, unsupported alias or helper mutation is a diagnostic, not a claimed empty footprint.
required_refinements.minimal_recipe: Use a cycle-safe complete AST traversal with qualified callable identity and internal structural site addresses. Resolve each patch's effective record fields through the same checked catalogue; if it may contain the selected due/sent field, count it as a write. Resolve transition field sets before accepting a delete/status exception. A fixed two-site allowlist validates exact create fields and exact optional parameter due field plus conditional none guard; it does not authorize all writes in the owning callable.
acceptance: Reject a second create/update site even in an otherwise unreachable branch, helper, unrelated action or inline route.
Reject an extra patch carrying due_at when no explicit set key names it, inherited patch field, conditional sent write and a lifecycle transition setting due/sent.
Retain actual unrelated delete/status transitions when their checked write sets are disjoint.
Renaming local parameters does not change hook identity; replacing supplied parameter/field does. Explicit nullable clear and optional omission remain distinct static facts.
Runtime atomicity/equal-value/rollback/ABA remain individually pending; no AST match is described as transaction proof.
required_refinements.classification: Concrete implementation coverage of existing DBSP04 no-bypass requirement, not a new language feature, alias solver or runtime gate.

required_refinements.title: Pin each phase's exact obligations, selected membership composition and admission cut
required_refinements.evidence: Existing MembershipContract.principal is an entity-name projection; ordinary local invoke checks permit any application-scoped binding of the same role type. Those APIs intentionally do not prove selected member identity, validator-to-principal composition or job phase authority. The recipe enumerates selection/admission/dispatch/completion phases but does not tabulate which checks occur in each. A generic phase grant or extra live dispatch/completion check would either broaden authority or alter the frozen admission cut.
required_refinements.refinement: Add the closed phase table directly to the static model contract: selection/enqueue permits only the listed eligible Todo fields and active authorized owner recipient email; admission rechecks current eligibility/revision/recipient and exact service credential/resolution/application membership before authorizing the selected immutable intent/operation; dispatch consumes that admitted bound authority under the frozen attempt contract, not an independent general invoke grant; completion retains exact receipt and writes only sent at compiler observation time under current fence plus original intent schedule_revision == current Todo schedule_revision and unsent. Do not invent another completion-time or dispatch-time role/recipient policy cut. Live obligations are requirements_not_proved, not effective permissions.
required_refinements.minimal_recipe: Resolve the selected application-scoped membership's effective member reference exactly to checked Service.id, with explicit reference precedence and dossier identity support; reject same-root nonidentity fields and wrong scope. Bind api_bearer.service_key's credential principal reference, the exact Principal.service variant and resolution id mapping to that Service identity. Preserve selected role enum variant and same authority-store identity; never substitute a global role union or merely principal kind. Audit each phase's exact allowed target set, validator/member identities and unresolved live requirements, with no credentials, recipient data or payload values.
acceptance: Wrong member identity, wrong application scope, same-primitive nonidentity field, other membership/validator, wrong principal resolution mapping and cross-job reuse reject.
A local ordinary ReminderRole.sender invoke rule alone never proves any phase permission or worker activation.
Paired ordinary email-read/output tests retain denials; field/entity policy and protected original policy bytes remain unchanged.
Admission obligations and post-admission completion guards are different records; no hidden post-admission reauthentication/visibility rule, no generic update/delete/provider invoke authority.
Same-store/nullability/identity failures are precise source diagnostics. Current live credential/membership/recipient checks remain unexecuted.
required_refinements.classification: Concrete expression of already frozen DBSP03/SERVICE authority, not an additional owner policy choice or runtime implementation requirement.

approved_architecture: Core owns opaque CheckedReminderDeliveryBinding private fields/constructor; candidate extraction in semantic analysis is explicitly not authority. A small resolved-facts candidate is appropriate because the effective Catalogue/TypeValue are private to semantic/typecheck.rs.
Reuse ordinary nominal schedule proof for both job classes, keep normal callable/signature/constructor diagnostics, and do not publish a delivery job as an ordinary row during preparation.

Exact nominal/reference/dossier identity, inherited nullable Instant due/sent and checked relationship aliases are the appropriate type evidence. Display strings, representation roots, inferred observations or name prefixes alone are insufficient.

Dedicated closed selection and completion graph kinds with binding-owned typed edges, not CallEdges, preserve nonordinary semantics. Add nodes only after ordinary resolution and all gates; key identities by tagged qualified job/binding/phase tuple, reject name/identity collisions, and keep node IDs/byte offsets internal.

Recursive sealed-use rejection is a valid bounded successor for the selected intent/request/receipt/service contracts. Permit exact contract declaration occurrences only; recursively cover refinements/type arguments/record and failure fields/defaults/signatures/routes/constructors and all expression use sites with cycle-safe visited sets. Do not seal unbound ordinary service types globally or rewrite ordinary calls to enqueue.

Closed selector retains strict non-null due < activation operation_time, checked open/visibility/unsent, required owner relationship and active-owner eligibility before order/limit, ordered due/id cursor and literal500. No generic query successor or SQL proof is inferred.

Versioned nested nonexecuting delivery audit may extend existing job facts without changing approval schema v5/canonicalization automatically. Preserve ordered cursor/payload associations; sort semantic sets by exact tagged identities. Bind every supported fact into decisions/digests/fresh expected export.
